gbm_population_evidence.quote: Histologically or cytologically confirmed incurable or metastatic solid tumors - colorectal, gastric, non-small cell lung, renal cell, breast, hepatocellular, ovarian, cervical cancer, GBM or with a potential benefit from PD-1/PD-L1 blockade

candidate_evidence.quote: Study DCBY02-101 is a multicenter, open-label, Phase 1 study to assess the effects of anti-CD93 mAb (DCBY02) as a monotherapy in patients with advanced or metastatic solid tumors.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: The malignancy must have progressed after at least 1 available standard therapy for incurable disease, and the patient has failed or is intolerant to all available therapies known to be active for the malignancy and have meaningful impact on the disease.

target_engagement_planned_evidence.quote: Dose expansion to further investigate safety, tolerability, and preliminary evidence of antitumor activity and characterize PK and PD of DCBY02.
must have a lesion that can be biopsied with acceptable clinical risk and agree to have a fresh biopsy at Screening and an on-treatment biopsy.

role_evidence.quote: A monoclonal antibody that binds to CD93, DCBY02 will be administered as a single intravenous (IV) infusion on Day 1 in each 21-day cycle.

agents.stated_antitumour_mechanism: monoclonal antibody that binds to CD93

coder_notes: Basket phase 1 of anti-CD93 mAb; GBM explicitly listed among eligible tumour types in inclusion criteria. Two experimental parts (escalation, expansion), no control, so control_arm_from_other_arms = no. PK parameters listed without sample type -> tumour_pk_planned unclear. Paired fresh and on-treatment biopsies plus a stated PD objective -> target_engagement yes, but the biopsy requirement explicitly excludes GBM patients. No tumour molecular biomarker requirement.
